title: storyink diagram spec
description: One spec shape for architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow and lifecycle diagrams, and pages ("type": "page") that embed them. See docs/spec.md.

change.description: Change metadata shown small above the diagram ("main → feat/batch").

changes.description: Written by resolveChanges / --changes (not hand-written): only the diff hunks the spec's elements reference (a DiffFile list from storyink diff, capped per file with a "… N more lines" row).

direction.description: Graph types only. Omit to auto-pick TB or LR by aspect ratio (closest to 16:10).

story.description: Storyboard (opt-in). "auto" derives steps from graph / message order; "changes" derives a change walkthrough from the deltas.

pace.description: Multiplier on the reading holds after each beat (default 0.6; 0 = no holds, 1 = the 0.3.5 holds, 1.5 = slower). Readers can change it in the viewer.

motion.description: Playback motion (default full). full: always animate; reduced: always step through settled steps; system: follow prefers-reduced-motion. The reader's toolbar choice and #motion= win.

camera.description: Viewer camera while playing (default follow). follow: zoom to a readable scale when fit is too small and pan to each step; fit: keep the whole diagram in view. The reader's Follow toggle and #camera= win.

hold.description: Reading hold (s) after the beat this step ends; overrides the computed hold (not scaled by pace).

apply.description: Diff code nodes: play the change (base version → diff), all remaining hunks or one (1-based).

focus.description: Camera / spotlight / veil target: an id, or several (their union box).

change.description: Apply these elements' delta look with motion (they show their before look until then).

oneOf.description: Derive a change walkthrough: before state, one beat per changed node (with its changed edges and attached diff), hero pulses, overview

spotlight.description: true: a soft light that follows the action. "veil": dim everything outside the step's focus (a soft rounded cutout that glides between steps).

rewind.description: Loop reset effect in the HTML viewer.

arrowheads.description: Draw arrowheads on graph edges (default false; sequences always have heads).

legend.description: Change legend (default: shown when any element has a delta other than unchanged; false hides it).

page.description: A page ("type": "page"): an explainer document of prose, data blocks and embedded diagrams. See docs/spec.md "Pages".

toc.description: Table of contents (default: shown with 4 or more sections).

layout.description: "slides" opens presenting (#present=0 forces the article); default "article".

present.description: Allow presenting (Present button, P, #present=1); default true.

pageBlock.description: A page block: exactly one type key, plus an optional anchor id.

prose.description: Safe Markdown subset: paragraphs, - / 1. lists, ### / #### headings, > quotes, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [text](url). No raw HTML.

spec.description: A diagram spec, or a path relative to the page file (resolved by the CLI / plugin).

builds.description: In slides, step through the figure's story beats (default true).

break.description: Starts a new slide inside the section (renders nothing in the article).

scrolly.description: Scrollytelling: the figure pinned beside step cards; each step moves the figure's story to its beat.

spec.description: A diagram spec, or a path relative to the page file (resolved by the CLI / plugin).

builds.description: In slides, step through the figure's story beats (default true).

at.description: A story step id, a chapter stop label, a 1-based beat number, "start" or "end".

narrate.description: Step narration for the HTML viewer's rail. heading defaults to the step's stop; a narrated step without a caption captions with its heading (or the body's first sentence).

cites.description: Spans of the body (exact text, in order) linked to an element id, "node#row", or a file path / path#L12 / path#L12-20.

delta.description: What the change did to this element (added = sage NEW, modified = gold CHANGED, removed = rose ghost, unchanged = receded context).

emphasis.description: hero: thicker stroke + glow (keep to 1–2 per diagram); muted: low opacity.

diff.description: code nodes: a diff shown with gutter and +/− rows. Unified hunk text, { file, lines?, context?, max? } (resolved by --changes), or resolved { file?, hunks }.

max.description: Fold after this many rows with "… N more lines" (default 24).

lines.description: 1-based inclusive line or [first, last]; head side unless removed / revision base.

kind.description: Shape and accent. Default: service / step / state.

tag.description: Small uppercase tag above the label. Architecture/dataflow default to the kind; "" hides it.

parent.description: Containing group id, or a composite state id (lifecycle).

counter.description: Rolling counter driven by story counter steps.

icon.description: chip: glyph before the label; panel/code: before the header title.

code.description: code only: source (string split on newlines, or a list of lines).

lang.description: code only (default ts; aliases python, golang, rs, yml, bash, shell, zsh, typescript, tsx, javascript, jsx are normalized).

size.description: panel/code: reserved body size; content swaps and typing never resize.

muted.description: Dimmed at rest (0.42); story undim lifts it.

summary.description: One line: what changed and why.

from.description: Node or group id, or an anchor: "panel#row", "code#3".

to.description: Node or group id, or an anchor: "panel#row", "code#3".

summary.description: One line: what changed and why.

kind.description: Free-form flavour shown next to the label: vpc, cluster, tier, region...

direction.description: Inner layout direction for this group's members (best-effort).

bare.description: Label only, no box (a column heading).

messageRef.description: 0-based index into messages, or a message id.

summary.description: One line: what changed and why.

outside.description: Draw after every frame that closes at the anchor message (default: inside the innermost frame).

bands.description: Background bands behind message ranges (Mermaid rect).

ref.description: Node, group or edge id, or an anchor: "panel#row", "code#3".

id.description: Anchor / story target: "<node>#<id>". Starts with a letter or _.

tag.description: Small uppercase line above the text.

text.description: Main text; wraps at the panel's size.cols (default 40).

delay.description: Start this many seconds after the step.

oneOf.description: "code#3" / "code#2-4" (display lines); diff nodes also "code#+14" (head line) / "code#-13" (base line).

hunk.description: Diff nodes: light hunk n's rows (1-based).
